name: review-intelligence
description: Retrieve and analyze app reviews into evidence-backed product, pricing, growth, and ASO insights.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve and turn app reviews into evidence-backed growth insight.
interface.longDescription: Give Review Intelligence an App Store or Google Play URL and its read-only Review Retriever connection can collect public written reviews for evidence-backed analysis. You can also upload an existing review export. The skill surfaces patterns and prioritizes product, pricing, growth, and ASO opportunities without treating reviews as proof of business outcomes.
defaultPrompt: Retrieve reviews from this App Store or Google Play URL and show me the first useful read.
Analyze this review export and find the strongest product, pricing, and ASO gaps.
Compare these competitor app URLs and reveal the most actionable gap.
